artifacts.summary: 6-phase implementation plan for adding .dia as 5th primitive constructor to Modal.Proposition with HasDia typeclass, simplified axioms, and updated truth lemmas across ~40 files

memory_candidates.content: When adding a new constructor to an inductive type that is pattern-matched across many files (like Modal.Proposition), the Lean 4 exhaustiveness checker guides the work: after adding the constructor, every pattern-match site raises an error indicating exactly where a new case is needed. This makes the change mechanically self-directing. The critical new proof obligation is typically in the truth lemma (completeness proof) where the new case requires a non-trivial witness construction.
